thread:
leo: Heads-up 9 webhook callback v2 changes format from streaming NDJSON (line-delimited tokens) to framed event objects {type: 'delta', data: ...}. Several customers use our webhook endpoint to stream tokens and will break. Need compatibility shim plan.
anika: Yikes. Which field changed? Example:
```
# v1 (ndjson lines)
{"token":"Hello"}
{"token":" world"}
{"stop":true}
```
vs
```
# v2 (framed json)
{"frame":"delta","payload":{"text":"Hello"}}
{"frame":"delta","payload":{"text":" world"}}
{"frame":"finish"}
```
jon: We could accept both formats on the server and normalize to internal frames. Cost: extra parser branch, slight CPU. Safer than forcing SDK changes.
priya: Thoughts about signature verification? v1 used `X-Redwood-Signature` HMAC over raw ndjson stream; v2 signs canonical framed JSON. Shim must verify signatures for both schemas or canonicalize before verify.
leo: Yes - plan: shim reads Content-Type or first bytes; if ndjson -> buffer minimal prefix to compute HMAC streaming, validate by streaming HMAC; if framed -> normal HMAC over body. We'll add metric `compat.webhook.ndjson_ingested`.
anika: Rollout: 1) add opt-in header `X-Redwood-Webhooks-Compat: accept-ndjson`? or better accept by default for now? I prefer accept-by-default for webhooks because integrators are fragile.
jon: Agree accept-by-default for 6 months, emit deprecation header `X-Redwood-Warn: ndjson-webhook-deprecated; planned-removal=2027-06-01`. Also log warnings to tenant account console.
priya: Security: rate-limit ndjson parsing to N tokens and timebox; stop parsing if token count > 50k to avoid OOM. Add per-connection CPU guard. Also ensure we re-stream to downstream consumers with new framed envelopes so internal services get a single shape.
ops-bot: canary deploy scheduled 1719610300. Logs: `deploy/webhook-compat-shim v0.1` :rocket:
leo: Add tests: fuzz ndjson lines with partial boundary and CRLF variations; test HMAC streaming with chunked transfers. Also update SDK docs and webhook quickstart so users can see deprecation timeline.
jon: I'll open PR in repo `platform/webhooks/shims/ndjson_adapter.go` and attach load numbers. Quick perf sanity: prototype in go shows ~3% CPU increase under 1k rps, tail latency +10ms p95 with large payloads.
anika: Ok. Let's publish short note in #product and #support so they can field tickets.
